zh.title: 全日空綠色寶可夢彩繪機首航檀香山 展開國際線營運
zh.summary: 全日空綠色寶可夢彩繪機於9月18日首航檀香山；波音787-9客機執飛國際航線。
body: 全日空（All Nippon Airways）最新推出的寶可夢主題彩繪客機「綠色寶可夢噴射機」（Green Pokémon Jet），於2026年9月18日正式投入國際航線營運。該架客機型號為波音787-9（國籍標誌暨登記號碼JA923A），首航執飛由東京羽田機場前往檀香山的NH186航班，預計於東京時間晚間9時55分起飛，並於當地時間下午近2時抵達檀香山，標誌著全日空最新特殊塗裝客機營運的正式展開。
這架波音787-9客機的機身塗裝以草屬性寶可夢為主題，除了經典角色皮卡丘之外，還繪有妙蛙種子、菊草葉、木守宮、草苗龜、藤藤蛇、哈力栗、木木梟、敲音猴以及新葉喵等眾多角色。全日空同時將寶可夢主題延伸至客艙內部，在豪華經濟艙與經濟艙座椅配備專屬頭墊巾，並於機上提供特別設計的杯子與雞尾酒餐巾紙，搭配寶可夢主題背景音樂，為長途國際航班打造獨特的搭乘體驗。

與今年7月投入日本國內線營運的波音787-8「紅色寶可夢噴射機」不同，這架JA923A綠色寶可夢彩繪機專門派飛全日空的國際航線網絡。根據航空公司規劃，該客機自東京羽田出發的可能航點包括檀香山、西雅圖、溫哥華、雪梨、馬尼拉、新加坡、德里、曼谷、雅加達與吉隆坡；自東京成田出發的可能航點則涵蓋曼谷、新加坡、雅加達、伯斯與孟買，目前國際航線計畫將持續執行至2027年3月27日。不過，該機型目前並無規劃派飛歐洲航線。

全日空與寶可夢的合作關係始於1998年，至今已延續近三十年。本次推出的最新一代寶可夢企劃適逢寶可夢紅／綠版遊戲推出30週年，以及全日空開啟國際航線營運40週年。最新企劃共規劃三架主題彩繪機，除了已上線的國內線「紅色寶可夢噴射機」（波音787-8，JA819A）與剛投入國際線的「綠色寶可夢噴射機」（波音787-9，JA923A）外，未來還預計推出以水屬性寶可夢為主題的「藍色寶可夢噴射機」（波音737-800，JA56AN），繼續執行國內線飛行任務。

en.title: ANA Launches Second 2026 Pokémon Jet With Inaugural Honolulu Flight
en.summary: All Nippon Airways introduced its Boeing 787-9 Green Pokémon Jet on an inaugural flight to Honolulu.
body: All Nippon Airways (ANA) has officially launched international passenger operations with its newest Pokémon-themed aircraft, the "Green Pokémon Jet." The Boeing 787-9 Dreamliner, registered as JA923A, was scheduled to make its inaugural international flight on September 18, 2026, operating flight NH186 from Tokyo Haneda to Honolulu. The flight departed Tokyo at 9:55 p.m. local time, marking the start of regular passenger service for the airline's latest specially painted long-haul aircraft.

The external livery of the Boeing 787-9 is centered around Grass-type Pokémon, featuring Pikachu alongside popular characters such as Bulbasaur, Chikorita, Treecko, Turtwig, Snivy, Chespin, Rowlet, Grookey, and Sprigatito. ANA has also integrated the theme throughout the passenger cabin. Premium Economy and Economy Class seats feature Pokémon headrest covers, and passengers are served using custom-designed cups and napkins. Additionally, thematic background music is played onboard during long-haul operations.

Unlike ANA's "Red Pokémon Jet"—a Boeing 787-8 introduced into domestic service in July—the Green Pokémon Jet has been assigned exclusively to international routes through March 27, 2027. Potential international destinations from Tokyo Haneda include Honolulu, Seattle, Vancouver, Sydney, Manila, Singapore, Delhi, Bangkok, Jakarta, and Kuala Lumpur. Flights operating out of Tokyo Narita may include routes to Bangkok, Singapore, Jakarta, Perth, and Mumbai. However, no flights are currently scheduled to destinations in Europe.

This latest initiative coincides with the 30th anniversary of Pokémon Red and Green and the 40th anniversary of ANA's international operations, continuing a collaboration between the airline and the franchise that began in 1998. The current generation of Pokémon aircraft comprises three jets: the domestic Boeing 787-8 (JA819A) Red Pokémon Jet, the newly launched international Boeing 787-9 (JA923A) Green Pokémon Jet, and an upcoming domestic Boeing 737-800 (JA56AN) Blue Pokémon Jet featuring Water-type Pokémon.

zh.title: 紐西蘭航空最後一架停飛波音787離澳洲沙漠復飛
zh.summary: 紐航最後一架停飛787離開澳洲沙漠；特倫特1000發動機風波結束
body: 根據Simple Flying於2026年9月18日報導，紐西蘭航空最後一架因特倫特1000發動機問題而停飛的波音787已離開澳洲沙漠存放地，結束長達9個月的地面停放狀態。
該報導指出，這標誌著紐西蘭航空已將特倫特1000發動機擾亂事件畫下句點，機隊全數恢復運營。
背景方面，波音787項目近期也有其他發展：美國聯邦航空局（FAA）已針對部分787機型發布機翼檢查指令；聯合航空與勞斯萊斯就發動機耐久性出現爭議；澳洲航空決定提前退役A380並轉向787等機型。

en.title: Air New Zealand's Last Grounded Boeing 787 Leaves Australian Desert After 9 Months
en.summary: Air New Zealand's last grounded 787 leaves Australian desert; Trent 1000 disruption ends
body: According to a report published by Simple Flying on September 18, 2026, Air New Zealand's last Boeing 787 that had been grounded due to Trent 1000 engine issues has left the Australian desert storage facility where it had been parked for nine months.
The article states that this departure marks the end of the Trent 1000 disruption for the airline, with its fleet now fully returned to service.

In related background, the Boeing 787 programme has seen other recent developments: the FAA issued an airworthiness directive for wing inspections on certain 787s; United Airlines is in a dispute with Rolls-Royce over engine durability; and Qantas has decided to retire its A380s early while converting orders toward 787s and A350s.

zh.title: 達美航空規劃2027年初在明尼阿波利斯-聖保羅建立A350基地
zh.summary: 達美航空擬2027年初於MSP設A350基地；深化佈局可開季節性長程航線
body: 根據Simple Flying於2026年9月18日報導，達美航空規劃於2027年初在明尼阿波利斯-聖保羅（MSP）建立空中巴士A350基地。
報導指出，深化MSP佈局可能解鎖季節性長程航線，並使關鍵跨大西洋航線機材現代化。
空中巴士A350亦為其他航空公司所採用，如加拿大航空已選擇最多16架A350-1000。
另據Simple Flying早前報導，聯合航空面臨勞斯萊斯引擎耐久性爭議，導致其45架A350存於風險。

en.title: Delta Air Lines Plans Minneapolis–St. Paul A350 Base for Early 2027
en.summary: Delta Air Lines plans MSP A350 base early 2027; deeper footprint may unlock seasonal long-haul routes
body: Delta Air Lines plans to open an Airbus A350 base at Minneapolis–St. Paul (MSP) in early 2027, as reported by Simple Flying on 18 September 2026.
The article notes that a deeper MSP footprint could unlock seasonal long-haul links and modernize aircraft on key transatlantic routes.
Air Canada recently selected up to 16 Airbus A350-1000 aircraft, highlighting continued demand for the type.
In related A350 developments, United Airlines is dealing with a Rolls-Royce engine durability dispute that puts 45 of its A350s at risk, per another Simple Flying article.
